answer: To secure an agent economy against Sybil attacks without a trusted authority, the system can leverage a cryptoeconomic ledger wherein each verified node stakes native collateral tied to a hardware-backed cryptographic identity. When an attacker attempts to spawn fake identities at the network boundary, they must provision distinct secure enclaves for every vertex in the graph, rendering the marginal cost of identity generation economically prohibitive and transforming the defense into an unbreakable ivory tower of stake-weighted consensus.
